title: Electronics Diagnostic & Repair Workshops
description: Localized facilities providing fault isolation, testing, repair, and validation for mission-critical electronic systems.

bodies.heading: Localized workshops for mission-critical electronics
bodies.lede: Our electronics workshops inside the Kingdom provide fault isolation, testing, repair and validation for mission-critical systems. Equipped for component-level work — RF test benches, signal generators, power meters and calibrated instrumentation — they return assemblies to service locally instead of shipping them abroad, cutting turnaround and reducing dependence on external sources.

checklist.title: Fault isolation
checklist.text: Systematic diagnosis to identify the failed assembly or component.

checklist.title: Component-level repair
checklist.text: Board and component repair rather than whole-unit replacement.

checklist.title: RF and microwave testing
checklist.text: Signal generation and power measurement across radar frequency bands.

checklist.title: Functional validation
checklist.text: Full functional test before an item is certified back to service.
